Which of the following is a cause of hypoparathyroidism?

A. Accidental removal or damage to the parathyroid glands during thyroid surgery  
B. Autoimmune destruction of the parathyroid glands  
C. Congenital absence of parathyroid glands (e.g., DiGeorge syndrome)  
D. All of the above

Correct answer: D. All of the above

Brief explanation: Hypoparathyroidism may result from surgical injury or inadvertent removal of the parathyroids (most common acquired cause), autoimmune destruction, congenital defects such as 22q11.2 deletion (DiGeorge) causing absent/underdeveloped glands, and less commonly metabolic causes (severe hypomagnesemia causing functional hypoparathyroidism).
